$comment: Authored (WP-F). Tokens the pipeline defines that neither the upstream inventory nor the Tecton export contains. All are provisional (D-002): no Tecton decision exists. Colours name palette paths.

tokens.name: --tecton-color-focus-inner
tokens.description: Inner ring of the documented double focus ring (D-005): drawn as box-shadow 0 0 0 1px between the control and the hot-pink outline on inverted surfaces, where pink alone is under 3:1 (dark-mode inverted surface #f6f5f8 is 2.75:1). It is the on-inverted ink: near-white on the light-mode inverted surface, near-black on the dark-mode one.
tokens.provisional: Pipeline-defined for D-005. Tecton defines a single focus colour; the inner ring is a proposal.

tokens.name: --tecton-color-scrollbar-thumb
tokens.description: Scrollbar thumb for scrollbar-color: the divider-strong step, 3:1 or more on the body and on the track. The thumb never depends on the track colour (macOS overlay scrollbars render a transparent track).
tokens.provisional: Pipeline-defined (styling.md 10, mwg:dark-mode). Tecton has no scrollbar design.

tokens.name: --tecton-color-scrollbar-track
tokens.description: Scrollbar track for scrollbar-color: fully transparent, so the thumb is always measured against the surface behind it.
tokens.provisional: Pipeline-defined (styling.md 10). Tecton has no scrollbar design.

tokens.name: --tecton-font-numeric
tokens.description: font-variant-numeric role for aligned digits (tables, stats, data variants). IBM Plex Mono is tabular by default; Figtree text needs this where the Tecton spec wants aligned numerals.
tokens.provisional: Pipeline-defined (styling.md 13). Tecton specifies tabular numerals only for the mono data variants.

tokens.name: --font-size-adjust-body
tokens.description: Numeric font-size-adjust for UI text: Figtree x-height 500/1000. Normalises fallback fonts during the font swap. Apply on component hosts, not on the document root. [mwg:visually-stable-font-fallbacks]
tokens.provisional: Pipeline-defined (styling.md 13); checked against the Capsize metrics by tokens:check.

tokens.name: --font-size-adjust-code
tokens.description: Numeric font-size-adjust for code: IBM Plex Mono x-height 516/1000. Keeps inline code visually matched in mixed text. [mwg:visually-stable-mixed-fonts]
tokens.provisional: Pipeline-defined (styling.md 13); checked against the Capsize metrics by tokens:check.
